chapters.label: Live: the 2008 final
chapters.text: The 2008 Futsal World Cup final, in Rio. Brazil play Spain. Schumacher, number eight, starts for Brazil. It ends two two, and Brazil win on penalties, four three!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: He was voted the second best player at that World Cup. He builds attacks from the back. This is how he does it: head up, he sees the crowded side, and switches the ball to the free side!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Head up, look, switch!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: keep your head up and switch play to the free side!
